$comment: Suites that are allowed to be reported as explicit skips when the gitignored
official card data is absent from a clean CI checkout.
Every entry was reviewed against the failure it produces without the data:
the suite reads packages/card-data/data/deck-catalog.json (directly, through
JSON import, or through apps/game-server/src/card-catalog.ts) and its failing
entries name that absent file. Suites here are still executed; only their
data-caused failing entries are reclassified, and they are listed in the job
summary.
A data-caused failure in a suite that is NOT listed here fails the job. That
is deliberate: adding a data dependency is a reviewable decision, and this
gate must not silently widen.
Reviewed 2026-10-15 against the pinned snapshot
which the live upstream sources no longer reproduce (see
probe-official-data-drift.mjs).
Re-reviewed 2026-10-16 for integration 1a7d7f8 (CI run 38834766320). Two
suites added there were verified the same way: they fail with 'Card catalog
file not found: .../deck-catalog.json' and pass once that file is present.
apps/game-server/tests/card-api.test.ts was NOT added: its single failing
test is a real assertion mismatch over Radiance availability and fails
identically with and without the official data (see below).

excludedAfterReview.reason: Not data-caused. The only failing test, 'rejects unreleased printings without banning released same-identity printing', is an assertion mismatch about Radiance availability. Verified 2026-10-16 at 1a7d7f8: it fails identically with and without packages/card-data/data/deck-catalog.json (16 tests, 1 failed, 15 passed both ways). Root cause is a wall-clock date boundary in apps/game-server/src/constructed-policy.ts: RADIANCE_EFFECTIVE_AT = 2026-10-16T00:00:00.000Z flips printingPolicies/status from previewNotReleased to available at that instant, while the test fixture expects the pre-activation branch. The CI run started 2026-10-16T01:22:30Z, i.e. after the boundary. Adding it here would hide a real failure.
